messages:
lena: Quick sync: we'll add tenant_metadata (nullable) + staged backfill in tonight's 02:00 UTC window. plan = online add + per-tenant worker jobs, index created CONCURRENTLY later.
omar: Sounds fine. expected blocking window?
lena: Only brief quiesce for final view/index swap ~30s. workers are rate-limited.
raj: Recommend initial canary 3% not 5% for this table, since it touches billing join. Also enforce replica lag guard at 20s.
lena: ok canary 3%, throttle to 50r/s if lag >20s, default 150r/s across 3 workers.
deploybot: slot reserved at 01:50 UTC, holdpoint requested at 02:06 UTC for canary.
ci-bot: CI: build 2150 for v3.7.1-schema-shadow passed :white_check_mark:
lena: pin = v3.7.1-tenantmeta-2026-03-21. rollback: stop workers + flip ff; column left nullable so reads safe; to revert read-path run pg:swap-views and pin back to v3.7.0.
omar: add alerting: replica_lag > 40s and canary error-rate >3%.
lena: done. runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/tenantmeta-stream
deploybot: canary started at 02:06 UTC (3%). monitoring hooks active.
ci-bot: smoke ok.  latency OK.
lena: workers ramping to 150r/s.
raj: seeing replica lag ~12s.
omar: if lag >=20s throttle to 50r/s.
lena: throttled to 50r/s.
deploybot: canary cleared. rolling to 20% next wave.
ci-bot: intermediate smoke for 20% -> ok.
lena: scheduling final CONCURRENT index create at wave 3; will swap read view after index ready.
raj: if swap hangs, abort and leave column; follow rollback steps.
deploybot: index created concurrently at 03:05:10 UTC, view swap at 03:05:35 UTC, no errors. rollout complete; release pinned v3.7.1-tenantmeta-2026-03-21.
lena: thanks team. post-deploy notes uploaded. tagged @eng-sre for FYI.
